features.text: UNIVERSAL UNLOADER SYSTEM: Delivers medial and lateral support with adjustable pneumatic air bladders.
SWING ASSIST TECHNOLOGY: Activates quadriceps to improve strength and gait efficiency by up to 50%.
HEAT-MOLDABLE CUFFS: Adapt to leg contours for a customized, secure fit.
LIGHTWEIGHT SINGLE-UPRIGHT FRAME: Enhances comfort without sacrificing knee stability.
IDEAL FOR POST-TKA & OA: Supports patients managing osteoarthritis or total knee replacement recovery.
FSA HSA ELIGIBLE: Use your Flexible Spending or Health Savings Account for this purchase.
PERFECT FIT GUARANTEE: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with our U.S.-based specialists.
